objects.description: The image depicts a modern minimalist prayer room with a traditional Indian element. The focal point is a recessed marble panel framed by dark wood, illuminated by recessed lighting. The smooth marble texture and warm color palette are traditional Indian design elements, while the simple design and lighting are contemporary. The space is organized to emphasize the cultural and spiritual significance of the marble panel.

description: The image showcases a modern interpretation of a bathroom wall panel design, featuring a sleek marble tile backdrop with a wooden frame. The marble tiles are smooth and glossy, with a beige and brown color palette, and are illuminated by undermount lighting, creating a warm and inviting ambiance. The wood framing adds a natural touch, enhancing the overall aesthetic. The design is sharp and contemporary, reflecting modern Indian interior design trends.
